## Booking.com Hotel Price & Amenity Search Scraper

**Actor:** [Booking.com Hotel Price & Amenity Search Scraper](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/booking-com-hotel-price-and-amenity-search-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/booking-com-hotel-price-and-amenity-search-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `destination` (string)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `checkIn` (string)
- `checkOut` (string)
- `adults` (integer)
- `rooms` (integer)
- `propertyType` (string)
- `minReviewScore` (number)
- `stars` (string)
- `freeCancellation` (boolean)
- `breakfast` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `name` (Hotel)
- `price` (Stay total)
- `pricePerNight` (Per night)
- `currency` (Currency)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `reviewCount` (Reviews)
- `reviewWord` (Score word)
- `stars` (Stars)
- `propertyType` (Type)
- `city` (City)
- `country` (Country)
- `freeCancellation` (Free cancellation)

description: Booking.com hotel prices for your dates: runs the Booking.com Hotel Price & Amenity Search Scraper Apify Actor, returns name, price, pricePerNight, rating, reviewCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
